notes: 14.1.5 Among the 626 Police Personnel killed on duty, during the year, 24 were Gazetted Officers, 533 Lower Subordinates (Constables 403, Head Constables 104 and Assistant Sub-Inspectors 26) and 69 Upper Subordinates (Sub-Inspectors 59 and Inspectors 10).

14.1.6 Of the 13 Police personnel from Delhi who lost their lives while performing duties, 12 were killed in ‘Accidents’, ‘Accidents’ also accounted for 8 lives in Ludhiana, 5 in Calcutta and 3 in Jaipur. ‘Riotous mobs’ in Delhi, Bangalore, Nagpur, Calcutta and Bombay caused injuries to 102, 47, 25, 20 and 16 Police personnel respectively.

14.2.1 As many as 3,151 police personnel of various ranks, 2,898 from States and 253 from the Union Territories, sustained injuries while performing their duties during the year 1996. State & UT-wise details of Police Personnel injured by type of duty/operation are given in Table-83.
